values.note: $25 per site; two vehicles or one RV included, $10 for a third vehicle; $10 day use. Same in the 2027 rate table. Cash, check or money order in the fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/chalk-lake-campground ('Single Site: $25 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 for third vehicle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231867/rates (2026 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 25), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: 'May to September', weather dependent; water, trash or a host may be missing early and late. 2026 dates are recreation.gov's fee seasons (first-come May 15-21, reservable May 22 - Sept 19).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/chalk-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use: May to September'; 'Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231867/rates (2026 seasons 05-15 to 09-19), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231867 (notice 'No hookups available') + campsite catalog for 231867 (all NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 19 sites: 12 for RVs/trailers/tents (all back-in) and 7 tent-only (7-9 and 11-14). Sites 4-9 and 14 are first-come; site 1 is the host's until mid-September, then first-come; the rest reservable. Forest Service: 'Maximum RV length is 50 feet' (the catalog gives few per-site lengths).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/chalk-lake-campground ('Chalk Lake Campground offers 19 sites'; 'Sites 4-9 and 14 are "walk-up," first-come, first-served sites'; 'Maximum RV length is 50 feet.') + campsite catalog for 231867 (12 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, 7 TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC; Driveway Entry Back-In), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Drinking water from a hand pump; firewood $10 a bundle at the host site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/chalk-lake-campground ('Restrooms: vault toilets'; 'Drinking water is available from a hand pump'; 'Firewood is available for sale at the host site for $10 per bundle'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov or 877-444-6777 up to 6 months and at least four days ahead, for the 2026 season May 22 - Sept 19; first-come the week before, and sites 4-9 and 14 are always first-come (occupy the night paid). Reserved weekends need Friday and Saturday nights, holiday weekends three; 'Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.' 14 consecutive nights at most. Normally full from Friday, sometimes Thursday.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/chalk-lake-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231867 (facility_rules minWeekendStay 2, minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 4; notice 'Reservations can be made up to 6 months in advance') + /rates (2026 Peak 05-22 to 09-19), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run sites).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/chalk-lake-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-26

note: Chalk Creek Canyon 8 miles up CR 162 from US-285 (Salida RD, Pike-San Isabel NF), about 8,700 ft below the white kaolinite cliffs, next to the Chalk Lake fishing site; a base for the Chalk Creek OHV roads. Camping in the canyon is allowed only in its four developed campgrounds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (2026-27), 19 sites, no hookups, reservable on recreation.gov. Changed max_rig_ft 35 -> 50 (FS: 'Maximum RV length is 50 feet'), pull_through false (all back-in). Added season May-Sept (05-15 to 09-19), reservable season 05-22 to 09-19, 6-month window, 4-day cutoff, 2/3-night minimums, 14-night limit, some_sites FCFS, vault toilets, hand-pump water, senior/access 50%. 7 of the 19 sites are tent-only. No alert on CR 162.
flags: Entry has no phone. The Forest Service page gives Salida Ranger District 719-539-3591; recreation.gov gives (661) 702-1420 'for facility specific information' (concessionaire, not named) and says the campground has no phone service.
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/chalk-lake-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
